scope: Complete native SM120 BF16/NVFP4 routed-expert GPU calls; routing-network, weight preparation, shared experts, EP communication and host submission excluded. Not serving throughput.
comparison: Original and bounded-policy processes independently tune native/Frost, then validate with native-Frost-Frost-native order. Cross-process original/bounded comparison uses the unchanged Frost path as a control; it is not a direct two-version ABBA run.
retention: All native candidate medians/errors, selected Frost control medians/errors, and frozen validation medians/errors; samples retained for selected native validation. Source paths are repository-relative. No device identifiers or host paths.

original.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
original.scope: BF16 input/output + routed FC1/activation + FC2/combine; identical checkpoint payloads, scales and routes. Host/preparation/routing network/shared experts/communication/serving excluded
original.numerical_contract: BF16 input and intermediate. Unless noted otherwise, BF16 expert outputs with FP32 accumulation/combine. FP4 Frost/cuTile/SM90 CUTLASS round FC1 preactivation to BF16; Prims-TS and both MXINT4 paths retain FP32 through activation. CuTe DSL also retains FP32 preactivation; SM12x and SM120 fused TC retain FP32 expert partials. SM12x uses FP16 partial products/accumulation internally. SM120 fused TC combines atomically into BF16 output. Separate references are recorded; different boundaries are not bitwise-equivalent math.
original.timer: CUPTI single-call first-to-last GPU activity span
original.native_search: All advertised native choices plus default; cuTile additionally enumerates the selected/all supported block-size stage pairs; SM120 native uses all same-thread small/large-tile pairs; expanded FP16 ranks top-two per stage plus default
